name: Starry Knight
source:
Diana has spent her life defending her friends and her kingdom, but a great loss has closed up her heart. Though she’s well prepared for war, there are some battles that a sword can’t slice through. When a mysterious princess finds herself wandering a crater, will Diana shrink back, or will learn to forgive herself and  conquer her most formidable enemy yet, her heart?  

[From [url=https://chanchangames.itch.io/starry-knight]itch.io[/url]]
